headline: 8 recurring failure patterns across 320 series
summary: The largest patterns are: Spiky Residuals with Low Bias (765 windows, 243 series); Lagging Seasonal Cycles (345 windows, 80 series); Persistent Under-prediction Level Shift (151 windows, 45 series). (summary composed from the cluster reports)
actions: Add event or promotion calendar features
Model differences or growth rates instead of levels
Use a shorter or recency-weighted training window to prioritize recent levels.
